svg.aria-label: A carbon-steel wok on a ring burner set into a small stove, with a long wooden-gripped handle. On a chopping board beside it: a bowl of day-old rice, a bowl of beaten egg, a dish of sliced scallion and a bottle of soy sauce. As the steps run, the burner lights, egg and rice go into the wok, soy and scallion follow, and the wok tosses the grains up through the hot air.
